entry.title: Awesome Connectivity Info Updates on Oct 28 - Nov 03, 2024
entry.content:
Global Indexes

  • GSMA Mobile Connectivity Index - Measures countries against four enablers of mobile internet adoption: Infrastructure, Affordability, Consumer Readiness and Content. (Methodology)
  • ITU ICT Development Index - Composite index based on three pillars: ICT Access, ICT Use, and ICT Skills. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2017)
  • Speedtest Global Index - Index of mobile and fixed broadband speeds from around the world on a monthly basis.
  • Internet Poverty Index - Internet poverty measure from World Data Lab.

Periodic Global Reports / Discontinued

  • Ericsson Mobility Report - Forecasts and analysis of mobile subscriptions, traffic, and network trends. (June 2026) (Nov 2025) (Jun 2025) (Q2 2024) (2024) · archive

Data and Measurement / Discontinued

  • Continent of Africa: High Resolution Population Density Maps - Meta HRSL datasets offering high-accuracy population mapping.
  • UN E-Government Knowledge Database - Country-level e-government development data from the UN; see also the UN E-Government Survey.

entry.title: Awesome Connectivity Info Updates on Mar 04 - Mar 10, 2019
entry.content:
Global Indexes / Discontinued

  • World Economic Forum - Networked Readiness Index - Earlier WEF edition of the Networked Readiness Index; succeeded by the Portulans Network Readiness Index (discontinued).
  • Cisco Visual Networking Index - Forecast and Trends, 2017–2022 White Paper (discontinued).

Connectivity Maps / Discontinued

  • African Undersea Cables - Steve Song's map of African undersea fibre optic cables.
  • African Terrestrial Fibre Optic Infrastructure - Map of African terrestrial fibre networks, Creative Commons, Open Data.
  • Africa Bandwidth Maps - Paul Hamilton's map of African terrestrial fibre and microwave networks.
  • GSMA Mobile Coverage Maps @ Mobile World Live - Somewhat dated but still useful map of mobile network coverage on a country-by-country basis.
  • ITU Broadband Atlas - Interactive infographic tool showcasing the status of broadband deployment worldwide and the regulatory landscape for broadband (discontinued).

Periodic Global Reports / Discontinued

  • Akamai State of the Internet / Connectivity Report - Connectivity report from large CDN company (last published 2017).
  • World Economic Forum - Global Information Technology Report - Examines the role of ICTs in driving innovation and includes the Network Readiness Index (discontinued).

Data and Measurement / Discontinued

  • Global Stats by StatCounter - Browser market share over time by browser, region, and OS.
  • Global Mobile Suppliers Association - Reports on LTE and 5G adoption.
  • InternetLiveStats - Internet users by country, interpolated from ITU, United Nations Population Division, Internet & Mobile Association of India (IAMAI), and World Bank data.
  • Internet World Stats - Internet users compiled from Nielsen and ITU statistics.
  • SimilarWeb - Mobile App Ranking - Ranking of popular mobile apps across countries.
  • LTE, WiMAX, HSPA+, 3G, GSM information by country - List of mobile networks around the world and their associated frequencies.

Data and Measurement / One-off reports

  • GSMA - Enabling Rural Coverage - Regulatory and policy recommendations to foster mobile broadband coverage in developing countries (last published 2018).
  • WEF Internet for All - Framework for accelerating internet access and adoption (last published 2016).
  • Kleiner Perkins Mary Meeker Internet Trends Report - Trends that affect and drive internet uptake globally (last published 2018).
entry.summary: 18 awesome projects updated on Mar 04 - Mar 10, 2019
